page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and running under the KVM hypervisor, this instance delivers 96 dedicated virtual CPUs.

The server provides 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Local attached storage is omitted from this configuration, relying on network storage solutions. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its substantial RAM-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated core allocation, the hardware structure is configured for high memory density. This instance profile suits memory-bound enterprise workloads, including large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning applications, high-capacity caching layers, and real-time data analytics engines.
